Quotes about feeling

Philosophy Quotes About Fear

Fear can protect life, but it can also distort judgment and enlarge superstition. Philosophers ask when fear is rational, when it should be trained, and what courage requires in its presence.

Quotes / About / Fear

10 quotations on fear

  1. There are more things that frighten us than crush us, and we suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
    Seneca
    Fear
  2. Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.
    Søren Kierkegaard
    Freedom
  3. Fear is the main source of superstition, and one of the main sources of cruelty. To conquer fear is the beginning of wisdom.
    Bertrand Russell
    Fear
  4. The Master said: When you have faults, do not fear to correct them.
    Confucius
    Philosophy
  5. When human life lay foully for all to see, crushed to the earth under heavy religion…
    Lucretius
    Fear
  6. The eternal silence of these infinite spaces frightens me.
    Blaise Pascal
    Philosophy
  7. the life of man, solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short
    Thomas Hobbes
    Nature
  8. The quest for certainty…has always been a quest for a peace that is assured.
    John Dewey
    Certainty
  9. Fear is the main source of superstition, and one of the main sources of cruelty.
    Bertrand Russell
    Fear
  10. The Master said: The wise are not perplexed; the humane are not anxious; the brave are not afraid.
    Confucius
    Wisdom
